{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=True).astype(float)

# Remove QA orders: revenue == 999999.99
qa_orders = data[data['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Number of QA orders found: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Remove QA orders and refunded orders
data_clean = data[(data['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99) & (data['status'] == 'completed')]

# Final data shape
print(f"Final data shape after cleaning: {data_clean.shape}")

# Check channel distribution
print("\nChannel distribution:")
print(data_clean['channel'].value_counts())

# Check customer_segment distribution
print("\nCustomer segment distribution:")
print(data_clean['customer_segment'].value_counts())

# Check conversion rate by channel
conversion_rates = data_clean.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()
print("\nConversion rate by channel:")
print(conversion_rates)

# Check average revenue by channel
avg_revenue_by_channel = data_clean.groupby('channel')['revenue_clean'].mean()
print("\nAverage revenue by channel:")
print(avg_revenue_by_channel)

# Check if channel and customer_segment are confounded
print("\nCross-tabulation of channel vs customer_segment:")
print(pd.crosstab(data_clean['channel'], data_clean['customer_segment']))"}
